caption_L1: Here a is a line graph labeled Bhutan : Infant mortality rate from 2009 to 2019 (in deaths per 1,000 live births). The x-axis plots Year along linear scale with a minimum of 2010 and a maximum of 2018 while the y-axis shows Deaths per 1,000 live births along linear scale of range 0 to 40.
caption_L2L3: The infant mortality rate in Bhutan has declined every year between 2009 and 2019.  The rate of decline has generally been consistent. From a rate of 36 deaths per 1000 live births in 2009, the rate declined to 24 per 1000 live births in 2019.
